about: A SHARED module of core as a boot-mounted component with no dialogs: the video pipeline the Production graph and Video Shots share (sequences, in-between strips, a shot's dialogue, the upscale plan), engine.js moved verbatim by tools/extract-engine.js. It provides exactly what it replaces, so every engine that bridges these names, the inline handlers in the HTML they draw, and core callers that stay reach them on window.
